description: Coverage register for all governed NYSC courses in the Programme Comparison Dashboard. It records which evidence exists for each course; it is not evidence itself. Course IDs, titles and headings come from the governed catalogue; comparator and mapping status from the stored benchmarking files. Regenerate with src/rag_prototype/build_coverage_register.py; do not edit by hand.

research_status.COMPLETE: Verified comparator records are linked, and a competency mapping exists or cannot be defended because NYSC headings are missing or unusable.
research_status.IN_PROGRESS: Comparator research has started but records or a defensible mapping are incomplete.
research_status.NOT_RESEARCHED: No official comparator research has been carried out for this course.
research_status.BLOCKED: Research was attempted and a documented obstacle prevents progress (blocking_evidence is required).

evidence_availability.HEADINGS_AVAILABLE: The governed catalogue publishes at least one usable NYSC module heading.
evidence_availability.NO_HEADINGS: The governed catalogue publishes no NYSC module headings.
evidence_availability.HEADINGS_UNUSABLE: Headings exist but name no curriculum content (e.g. a fee note or a generic statement).

presentation_mode.FULL_COMPARISON: NYSC headings, verified comparators and a completed competency matrix with Areas to Investigate.
presentation_mode.COMPARATORS_ONLY: Verified comparator records without a matrix, because no defensible NYSC competency mapping is available.
presentation_mode.RESEARCH_PENDING: External comparator research has not been completed; no comparator records are linked.
presentation_mode.EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE: Research was attempted, but the documented evidence is insufficient (research_status BLOCKED).

definitions.current_presentation_mode: Derived only from verified, stored evidence (linked records, mappings, research status); never from the proposed mode.
definitions.proposed_presentation_mode: The target mode once research is complete; it is not shown on the dashboard as coverage.
definitions.evidence_availability_scope: Evidence availability describes NYSC headings only; it says nothing about whether external comparators exist.
definitions.verified_heading_count: Governed headings minus headings flagged for review; zero when the headings are unusable.

reconciliation: The Step 17 audit counted 49 occupation groups by merging five different languages and several distinct occupations; this register uses 62 groups, keeping occupations that would need different comparators separate and recording close siblings in related_courses.

The Step 17 audit said at most 28 courses could receive a full comparison (6 + 22). The governed catalogue has 32 courses with headings; 3 of them (COURSE-072, COURSE-074, COURSE-086) contain no curriculum content, so 29 courses (6 complete + 23 not yet researched) have usable headings.

The Step 17 audit placed about 9 courses in a 'not comparable' tier before any research. That is withdrawn: no unresearched course is classified as permanently not comparable, and none is BLOCKED because no research has been attempted.

Step 18B: current_presentation_mode now uses RESEARCH_PENDING for courses whose comparator research has not been completed; EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE is reserved for BLOCKED research. Courses with verified comparators but no defensible mapping are COMPLETE (missing or unusable headings) or IN_PROGRESS (mapping still to do), never NOT_RESEARCHED.

The Step 17 section-1 table's group and course counts did not match its batch table (e.g. 8 hard groups / 8 courses against 9 groups / 11 courses). The totals below are computed directly from the course entries.
